mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates active monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.7% signals labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative equity sentiment and S&P 500 underperformance over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >40% of cases (5-day returns positive when both series decline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months) signals manufacturing slowdown, increasing recession probability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 for two months (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed monetary tightening and negative equity returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1250 thousand units in two months indicates housing sector weakness, triggering broader economic slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1250 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals labor market tightening combined with monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >40% of cases (5-day returns positive when PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS rises).

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% for two consecutive quarters) indicates economic deceleration, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% for two quarters (t-test p-value > 0.05).
